Package com.egradx.auth.web

Class EgradxMyAccountController

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.web.EgradxMyAccountController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/egradx/auth/my") @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()") public class EgradxMyAccountController extends Object
The signed-in person's own account: password, sessions, organizations and sign-in address.

Changing the password and signing out everywhere both end every session — this one included — and return a fresh session in its place, so the caller swaps its tokens and carries on.
